text.p: These are the headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Army feared for life, doctor says: Danger of drunken soldiers brought bodyguards after murder claim, Somali inquiry told.
- Ontario to scrap offloading proposal: Talks with cities focus on new plan.
- Jordanian slaughters Israeli girls: Massacre at peace site caps period of growing crisis in Middle East relations.
- Sexual identity predominates: Case of boy raised as girl underscores importance of prenatal events, MDs say.
- Eaton's store closings will hurt city cores: Civic officials fear impact of vacancies.
Son dies, man charged with murder.
- Albanian families rush for arms: Visitors shoved into ammunition store as gunfire erupts.
- Sun Media to buy Blackburn papers: Media concern signs letter of intent for London Free Press, Netmar community chain.
- Markets dive after U.S. report sparks rate fear: Investors turn to bears on shoppers being bulls in February.
- Hudson's Bay chief retiring: Barron seen as Kosich's successor.
- Polygram to proceed with film company: Not deterred by exemption denial.
- Markets take hammering: Equities and bonds tumble on threat of U.S. budget deadlock.
- Sun Media buys London Free Press.
